# SD18 deterministic Human Monk level 11 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk
# level-1..level-10 martial chassis baseline (tests/sd13_monk_level10_progression.rs)
# to level 11 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1 through level-10
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this slice needs.
#
# The PF1 CRB Monk class table's level-11 "Special" column reads "Diamond
# body" only (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and
# legacy.aonprd.com) — a flat poison-immunity grant, mirroring the 5th-level
# Purity of Body (disease immunity) grant-only identity idiom exactly. No
# other new named feature lands at level 11. It deliberately avoids every
# later Monk burden surface: no execution of what the recognized bonus feat
# actually does, no repeat bonus-feat grant recognition, no ki-power
# execution, no ki-strike damage-reduction-bypass resolution, no
# fall-damage engine, no High Jump, no Wholeness of Body execution, and no
# level-12+ progression.

class_level=class:monk:11
